parishioners are welcome. refreshments will take place in the parish centre afterwords. mass of the angels – st joseph’s church on thursday, november 12th at 7pm we will be celebrating a mass of angels in st joseph’s church to remember babies and children who have died over the years through miscarriage, stillbirth, cot death, illness and accident. as a community, we join together to remember the lives of these children and pray with their families. “before i formed you in the womb, i knew you”. jeremiah 1: 5 holy souls – november list of dead holy souls envelopes are now available at the . world youth day 2027 limerick diocese is seeking an expression of interest from young people aged 19 or over that may be interested in traveling to seoul in 2027. cost approx: €3,000 – support provided in raising cost. final date to be confirmed: 30th july to august 9th approx. please contact

to express your interest. religious education and faith development (refd) the diocese of limerick provides a sacramental preparation programme called religious education and faith development for children who wish to celebrate first holy communion or confirmation but do not attend a school under catholic patronage in the diocese. weekly online classes are available for children in 1st, 2nd, 5th, and 6th classes , complemented by a number of face-to-face gatherings during the yea r. the programme begins in october and continues until may . to be eligible to receive first holy communion or confirmation , children are required to attend refd classes for two consecutive years before receiving the sacrament . further details available from catherine mulcahy
